signature: SUBROUTINE DTBTRS( UPLO, TRANS, DIAG, N, KD, NRHS, AB, LDAB, B,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$  (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: diag
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: A is non-unit triangular;
-   `= 'U'`: A is unit triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kd
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals or subdiagonals of the triangular band matrix A. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The upper or lower triangular band matrix A, stored in the first kd+1 rows of `AB`. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$. If `DIAG = 'U'`, the diagonal elements of A are not referenced and are assumed to be 1.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KD}+1$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the i-th diagonal element of A is zero, indicating that the matrix is singular and the solutions X have not been computed.
